title: Making History
start: Talk to Jorral in the outpost south of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, north-west of West Ardougne.

ironman.t: 24 Crafting (if making your own sapphire amulet)

items.t: Spade (or the meerkats familiar; the spade can be purchased from Richard's Farming Shop during the quest)
2 ecto-tokens (or completion of Ghosts Ahoy), or 2,600 coins (1,300 coins after Cabin Fever) to charter ships from Port Sarim to Port Phasmatys
A ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (not required if you have completed the hard Morytania achievements)

recommended.t: Activated Ardougne and Fremennik Province lodestones
A dramen or lunar staff for the use of fairy rings, unless you've completed A Fairy Tale III - Battle at Ork's Rift

rewards.t: The enchanted key, allowing you to go on your own treasure digs until it disappears; see the enchanted key lore activity
Access to the museum in the Outpost
You can read an incomplete list of all your exploits during the quest on the bookcase at the Outpost, but cannot take it away.

You can return to Droalak in Port Phasmatys after the quest and upon learning of what happened, he will finally be at peace and will disappear. Doing so is a requirement for obtaining the master quest cape.
You can talk to Historian Minas in the Varrock Museum to receive 5 Kudos and an antique lamp that gives 1,000 experience in a skill of level 20 or above.

steps.t: Go to the Outpost; an old, now-derelict tower to the north of West Ardougne.

sub.t: Traveller's necklace teleports directly to the Outpost.
Eagles' Peak lodestone and run south, then south east.

steps.t: Speak with Jorral for a cutscene. [Chat: 1 Tell me more.]
After the cutscene, agree to help. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to the silver merchant in the East Ardougne marketplace. [Chat: 3 Ask about the outpost.]

sub.t: Do not steal from the stall otherwise the merchant will not talk with you.

steps.t: Ring of dueling to Castle Wars, run north and cross the bridge south of the Observatory.

sub.t: West of fairy ring CIQ and north-west of Yanille lodestone.

steps.t: When you're just north of the bridge, play hot-and-cold by feeling the key and walking around until it feels steaming hot, and use the spade to dig. (Between the two trees)
Use the key on the chest to unlock it.
Speak to Droalak south of the General Store in Port Phasmatys.

sub.t: Ectophial or Port Sarim lodestone and charter ship to Port Phasmatys.

steps.t: Talk to Melina in the building east of the General Store with a sapphire amulet in your inventory.
Talk to Droalak again for the scroll.
Talk to Blanin, west of the cow pen in Rellekka.
Talk to Dron, west of the helmet shop. [Chat: 3 I'm after important answers. › 2 Why you're the famous warrior Dron!]

Answer his quiz. [Chat: 2 An iron mace. › 1 Breakfast. › 2 Lunch. › 1 Bunnies. › 2 Red. › 2 36. › 1 8. › 3 Fifth and Fourth. › 3 Northeast side of town. › 1 Blanin. › 1 Fluffy. › 1 12, but what does that have to do with anything?]
Return to Jorral at the outpost, talk to him until he gives you a Letter.
Talk to King Lathas on the floor 2 of Ardougne Castle. (Remove Mourner Outfit if equipped)

get_inside.text: The Spirit tree at the crossroads south of the Grand Tree can be accessed from the Tree Gnome Village — it is on the northwest side, near the small obelisk. The north-east Grand Exchange tree is the easiest access to the network, with the South Feldip Hills tree (use a ring of duelling) or the Port Sarim farming patch tree following in convenience. After the Grand Tree this tree can send the player outwards to any other tree in the network, but incoming players must still go through the Tree Gnome Village hub.
Seed pods from the Gnome Restaurant minigame will instantly summon transport to the Grand Tree. They are consumed after one use.
Hazelmere's signet ring provides an unlimited free teleport (next to Argento and Hazelmere's statue).
Walk through the front gate. The first time you enter there is a small dialogue with Femi. The gate can be reached from the following locations:
A traveller's necklace can be used to teleport to the Outpost. The player can run north-north-east to reach the gate, after a short distance.
North-west from East Ardougne or west from the Fishing Guild — the Ardougne lodestone can be used to get to the guild.

The Gnome glider hub is located on the top level of the Grand Tree. Easiest access to this network is through the Al Kharid lodestone, but this network also connects to the fairy ring network and other useful locations.
There are two Agility shortcuts from nearby areas:
There is a stile over the western fence into the terrorbird pen, which is a short distance south from the Eagles' Peak lodestone. It requires 61 Agility.
With 37 Agility after the The Grand Tree quest: straight into the Grand Tree itself, south-west from Barbarian Assault (by Games necklace).
